lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Now, let's be honest. What did he tell you? What did he show you?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did you see and what did he tell you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He showed me the knife and the rope.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where was she? Come on we know this already. Be honest.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In the back of the jeep.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: She was in the back of the jeep? (Brendan nods "yes") Was she alive or dead at that time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Dead

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Are you sure? (Brendan nods "yes") OK. What did you see in the back, now this is hard, but what did you see in the back of the jeep?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That she was laying there with like a small blanket over her.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you remember where her head was?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head "no") Not really.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did she have clothes on?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah (nods "yes").

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: She was clothed.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods "yes") Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was she tied up already? Or did you help him do that? (Brendan shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She was tied up already.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Where? Tell me how she was tied up.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like the rope was right here around her body.
